display_name: Private Student Loan Disclosure & Rescission Checker
purpose: Checks a private-education-loan disclosure-element checklist across the three 12 CFR 1026.46-48 stages (application/solicitation, approval, final), the HEOA self-certification-form presence requirement, and computes the 3-business-day right-to-cancel window from a declared final-disclosure date (skipping weekends and any declared holiday dates). Federal Income-Driven Repayment (IDR) calculations are explicitly out of scope v1 -- flagged as a future rider trigger, not built, because those formulas churn on a policy cycle distinct from the stable 1026.46-48 requirements checked here.
